title: Secure Webhook Ingestion Patterns
excerpt: Webhook endpoints are public and at-least-once by design. Without signature verification and idempotent handlers, duplicate deliveries become double charges and duplicate CRM rows.
description: Staff patterns for secure webhook ingestion: HMAC validation, timestamp skew, replay protection, tenant rate limits, and DLQ visibility for failed deliveries.
socialThreadTr: Webhook duplicate delivery idempotency olmadan çift ücret demek. 🧵

sections.heading: Webhooks are a public surface
paragraphs: Providers retry aggressively; load balancers deliver duplicate POSTs even when your handler succeeded the first time.
Verify signatures on the raw request body. Parsing JSON first breaks canonicalization and invites subtle bypass bugs.

sections.heading: HMAC and replay stores are mandatory
paragraphs: Keep timestamp acceptance windows tight and store seen event ids to block replays.
Per-tenant rate limits and maximum body sizes defend against DDoS and accidental megabyte payloads.
points: Require HMAC signatures, timestamp skew limits, and replay stores
Separate body size and rate limits per tenant
Make handlers idempotent for safe duplicate delivery
Surface failed deliveries through DLQ metrics and alerts

sections.heading: Handlers must be idempotent
paragraphs: Do not return 200 until side effects are deduplicated with an idempotency or natural key.
Use event version fields to handle out-of-order delivery without corrupting state.

sections.heading: DLQ metrics expose failure
paragraphs: Route persistent failures to a DLQ and alert on age and depth—not only on HTTP 5xx from your edge.
Provide a manual replay tool with audit logging so support cannot silently re-run finance events.

sections.heading: Authenticate before you parse
paragraphs: Signature verification must run on raw bytes before JSON parsers mutate the body. Enforce timestamp skew windows and store delivery identifiers in a replay table with TTL aligned to partner documentation. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Per-tenant rate limits and maximum body sizes at the edge protect workers from volumetric abuse by a single integration. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Return four hundred one for authentication failures and four hundred twenty-two for schema violations so on-call can triage without reading secrets in chat. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

sections.heading: Make retries safe for money paths
paragraphs: Handlers commit outcomes keyed by partner idempotency tokens before returning two hundred. Document which events touch money, inventory, or identity and require human review on ambiguous retries. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

DLQ depth, oldest message age, and failure signatures by schema version should page owners, not sit in silent buckets. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Classify webhook fields before shipping them to shared observability backends; PCI and health payloads may need dedicated ingestion accounts. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

sections.heading: Ingestion hardening beyond signature checks
paragraphs: HMAC verification is necessary but not sufficient when replay windows are unbounded or body parsers execute before authentication. Enforce timestamp skew limits, constant-time signature comparison, and a durable replay store keyed by delivery identifier. Reject oversize bodies at the edge with per-tenant rate limits so one noisy partner cannot exhaust workers. Retain redacted raw bodies only in encrypted buffers with short TTL. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Handlers must be idempotent because vendors retry aggressively on any ambiguous response. Persist processing outcomes with the same idempotency key the partner supplies, returning two hundred only after side effects commit. Separate verification failures—four hundred one—from business validation failures so on-call can distinguish attacks from schema drift without reading raw payloads in chat. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Dead-letter queues need metrics, not silent S3 folders. Alert on DLQ growth rate, oldest message age, and repeated failure signatures tied to schema versions. Run contract tests against sample webhook fixtures in CI whenever you change parsing code. Penetration tests should include replayed signed bodies from captured traffic stored in redacted fixtures. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Document data classification for webhook fields before logging them to general observability backends. PCI and PII-bearing events may require dedicated ingestion accounts and shorter retention. Product managers requesting new webhook types owe a threat model covering spoofing, replay, and volumetric abuse, signed off before endpoints go public in partner documentation. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

tr.title: Güvenli Webhook Alma Kalıpları
tr.excerpt: Webhook uçları genelde halka açıktır ve en az bir kez teslimat garantisi vardır. İmza doğrulaması ve idempotency olmadan duplicate event'ler finans ve CRM'de çift yan etki yaratır.
tr.description: Staff webhook ingestion: HMAC, timestamp skew, replay koruması, tenant rate limit ve DLQ görünürlüğü.

sections.heading: Webhook herkese açık bir yüzeydir
paragraphs: Sağlayıcılar aynı event'i retry eder; siz de load balancer arkasında duplicate POST alırsınız.
Raw body üzerinde imza doğrulayın; JSON parse sonrası canonicalization imzayı kırar.

sections.heading: HMAC ve replay store zorunlu
paragraphs: Timestamp penceresi dar tutulmalı; replay store eski event id'lerini reddetsin.
Tenant başına rate limit ve max body boyutu DDoS ve fat-finger payload'lara karşı korur.
points: HMAC imza, timestamp skew ve replay store zorunlu kılın
Webhook body boyutu ve rate limit'i tenant bazında ayırın
Idempotent handler ile duplicate delivery'yi güvenli yapın
Başarısız delivery'leri DLQ ve alert ile görünür kılın

sections.heading: Handler'lar idempotent olmalı
paragraphs: Handler side effect'i idempotency key veya natural key ile dedupe etmeden 200 dönmeyin.
Out-of-order delivery için event versiyon alanı kullanın.

sections.heading: DLQ metrikleri ile başarısızlık görünür
paragraphs: Kalıcı başarısız delivery'leri DLQ'ya yazın ve yaş, derinlik metrikleri ile alert kurun.
Manuel replay aracı audit log ile birlikte sunulmalı.

sections.heading: Parse etmeden önce authenticate
paragraphs: İmza doğrulama JSON parser body'yi değiştirmeden raw byte üzerinde çalışmalı. Timestamp skew penceresi zorunlu kılın; delivery id'leri partner dokümantasyonu TTL'siyle replay tablosunda tutun. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

Edge'de tenant başına rate limit ve max body size tek entegrasyonun volumetric abuse'ünü worker'lardan uzak tutar. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

Auth failure için dört yüz bir, schema ihlali için dört yüz yirmi iki dönün; on-call chat'te secret okumadan triage edebilsin. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

sections.heading: Retry'leri para yollarında güvenli kılın
paragraphs: Handler'lar partner idempotency token'ı ile outcome commit edip sonra iki yüz dönsün. Para, stok veya kimlik dokunan event'leri yazın; belirsiz retry'de insan review şart. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

DLQ derinliği, en eski mesaj yaşı ve schema versiyon failure imzası owner'ı pages etsin, sessiz bucket'ta kalmasın. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

Paylaşılan observability'ye göndermeden webhook alanlarını sınıflandırın; PCI ve health payload ayrı ingestion account gerektirebilir. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın. Servis kataloğunda değişikliği izleyin, eşikleri çeyreklik gözden geçirin ve bir sonraki launch penceresinden önce tarihli rollback ticket ekleyin.

sections.heading: İmza kontrolünün ötesinde ingestion sertleştirme
paragraphs: Replay penceresi sınırsızken veya body parser auth'tan önce çalışırken HMAC yeterli değildir. Timestamp skew limiti, constant-time signature karşılaştırması ve delivery id ile keyed kalıcı replay store zorunlu kılın. Oversize body'leri edge'de tenant başına rate limit ile reddedin; gürültülü partner worker'ları tüketmesin.

Handler'lar idempotent olmalı; vendor belirsiz yanıtta agresif retry eder. Partner'ın idempotency key'i ile işlem sonucunu persist edin, side effect commit olmadan iki yüz dönmeyin. Doğrulama failure'larını—dört yüz bir—iş validation failure'larından ayırın; on-call saldırı ile schema drift'i chat'te raw payload okumadan ayırsın.

DLQ metrik ister, sessiz S3 klasörü değil. DLQ büyüme hızı, en eski mesaj yaşı ve schema versiyonuna bağlı tekrarlayan failure imzalarında alert. Parsing kodu değişince CI'da örnek webhook fixture'larına contract test koşun. Pen test redakte fixture'lardaki imzalı body replay'ini içersin.

Genel observability backend'lerine loglamadan önce webhook alanları için veri sınıflandırması yazın. PCI ve PII taşıyan olaylar ayrı ingestion account ve kısa retention gerektirebilir. Yeni webhook isteyen PM spoofing, replay ve volumetric abuse threat model'i sunsun; partner dokümanında public olmadan onaylansın.

sections.heading: Retries auf Geld-Pfaden sicher machen
paragraphs: DLQ-Tiefe, oldest age, Failure-Signaturen pro Schema-Version paget Owner. Änderung im Service-Katalog tracken, Schwellen vierteljährlich reviewen und datiertes Rollback-Ticket vor dem nächsten Launch-Fenster anhängen.

sections.heading: Ingestion-Härtung jenseits Signaturen
paragraphs: HMAC allein reicht nicht bei unbounded Replay oder Body-Parser vor Auth. Timestamp-Skew-Limits, constant-time Signature-Vergleich, durable Replay-Store keyed by Delivery-ID. Oversize Bodies am Edge mit per-Tenant Rate Limits ablehnen. Tragen Sie Owner, Review-Datum und Rollback-Trigger im selben Change-Ticket ein.

Handler idempotent—Vendors retrien bei ambiguous Response. Outcomes mit Partner-Idempotency-Key persistieren; 200 erst nach Side-Effect-Commit. Verification-Failures 401 von Business-Validation trennen für On-Call ohne Raw-Payload-Chat. Tragen Sie Owner, Review-Datum und Rollback-Trigger im selben Change-Ticket ein.

DLQ braucht Metriken: Wachstumsrate, oldest age, wiederkehrende Failure-Signaturen pro Schema-Version. Contract-Tests auf Webhook-Fixtures in CI bei Parser-Änderungen. Pentest mit replayed signed Bodies aus redigierten Fixtures. Tragen Sie Owner, Review-Datum und Rollback-Trigger im selben Change-Ticket ein.

Datenklassifikation für Webhook-Felder vor Logging in generelle Observability. PCI/PII-Events evtl. dedizierte Ingestion-Accounts und kürzere Retention. PMs für neue Webhook-Typen liefern Threat Model Spoofing, Replay, Volumetric Abuse vor Public Partner-Docs. Tragen Sie Owner, Review-Datum und Rollback-Trigger im selben Change-Ticket ein.

zh.title: 安全 Webhook 摄入模式
zh.excerpt: Webhook 端点通常公开且至少一次投递。无签名与幂等时，重复事件会在财务与 CRM 产生双倍副作用。
zh.description: Staff webhook 摄入：HMAC、时间戳偏移、防重放、租户限速与 DLQ 可见性。

sections.heading: Webhook 是公开面
paragraphs: 供应商会重试；负载均衡后仍会收到重复 POST。
在 raw body 上验签；先 parse JSON 会破坏规范化。

sections.heading: 强制 HMAC 与重放存储
paragraphs: 时间戳窗口要窄；重放存储拒绝旧 event id。
按租户限速与 body 上限防 DDoS 与超大 payload。
points: 强制 HMAC 签名、时间戳偏移与重放存储
按租户区分 body 大小与速率限制
幂等处理器安全处理重复投递
失败投递经 DLQ 与告警可见

sections.heading: 处理器必须幂等
paragraphs: 未对副作用 dedupe 不要返回 200；用幂等键或自然键。
乱序投递用 event 版本字段。

sections.heading: DLQ 指标暴露失败
paragraphs: 持久失败写入 DLQ；对年龄与深度告警。
手动重放工具需配审计日志。

sections.heading: 解析前先认证
paragraphs: 签名验证须在 JSON 解析器改动 body 前对 raw byte 执行。强制 timestamp skew 窗口，并在 replay 表按 partner 文档 TTL 存储 delivery id。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
边缘按租户限流与 body 上限，防止单一集成 volumetric abuse 拖垮 worker。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
认证失败返回 401，schema 违规返回 422，便于 on-call 无需在聊天中读 secret 即可分流。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。

sections.heading: 让重试在资金路径上安全
paragraphs: 处理器在返回 200 前用 partner 幂等 token 提交 outcome。记录触及资金、库存或身份的事件；含糊 retry 须人工复核。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
DLQ 深度、最旧消息年龄与按 schema 版本的失败签名应 paging owner，而非躺在静默桶中。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
写入共享可观测前先分级 webhook 字段；PCI 与健康 payload 可能需要独立 ingestion 账户。 请在下次生产评审中复核这一点，指定负责人并关联带日期的整改工单。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。

sections.heading: 超越签名校验的接入加固
paragraphs: 当 replay 窗口无界或 body 解析器在认证前执行时，HMAC 必要但不充分。强制 timestamp 偏移上限、常数时间签名比较，以及以 delivery id 为键的持久 replay 存储。在边缘按租户限流拒绝超大 body，避免 noisy partner 耗尽 worker。
处理器必须幂等，因为供应商对任何含糊响应都会激进重试。用伙伴提供的幂等键持久化处理结果，仅在副作用提交后返回 200。将验证失败（401）与业务校验失败分开，便于 on-call 在不于聊天中读 raw payload 的情况下区分攻击与 schema drift。
DLQ 需要指标而非静默 S3 目录。对 DLQ 增长率、最旧消息年龄及与 schema 版本绑定的重复失败签名告警。解析代码变更时在 CI 对示例 webhook fixture 跑 contract test。渗透测试应包含来自 redact fixture 的重放签名 body。
写入通用可观测后端前先为 webhook 字段做数据分级。含 PCI/PII 的事件可能需要独立 ingestion 账户与更短 retention。产品经理申请新 webhook 类型须提交涵盖 spoofing、replay 与 volumetric abuse 的威胁模型，并在伙伴文档公开前获批。

sections.heading: ハンドラは冪等
paragraphs: 副作用dedupe前に200返さない；冪等キーか自然キー。
順不同配信用event版フィールド。

sections.heading: DLQ指標で失敗可視
paragraphs: 永続失敗をDLQへ；経過と深さでアラート。
手動リプレイツールは監査ログ付き。

sections.heading: parse 前に authenticate
paragraphs: signature verify は JSON parser 前に raw byte で。timestamp skew window と delivery id replay table。edge で tenant 別 rate limit と body max。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
auth fail 401、schema violation 422 で triage。handler は partner idempotency token で outcome commit 後 200。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
money/inventory/identity event は ambiguous retry で human review。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: money path で retry を safe に
paragraphs: DLQ depth、oldest age、schema version failure signature が owner page。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
shared observability 前に webhook field classify；PCI/health は dedicated ingestion account の可能性。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
新 webhook は public partner doc 前 threat model。 次回の production review で再確認し、オーナーを割り当て、日付付き remediation チケットを紐付けてください。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: 署名チェックを超える ingestion 硬化
paragraphs: replay 窓が unbounded だったり body parser が auth より先なら HMAC だけでは不十分。timestamp skew limit、constant-time signature compare、delivery id keyed durable replay store を enforce。oversize body は edge で tenant 別 rate limit で reject。

handler は idempotent—vendor は ambiguous response で aggressive retry。partner idempotency key で outcome persist；side effect commit 後に 200。verification failure 401 を business validation failure と分離し on-call が raw payload なしで attack と schema drift を区別。
DLQ は metric 必須：成長率、最古 message age、schema version 別 repeated failure signature。parser 変更のたび CI で webhook fixture contract test。pentest は redacted fixture から signed body replay を含む。

general observability に log する前に webhook field の data classification。PCI/PII event は dedicated ingestion account と短 retention の可能性。新 webhook を求める PM は partner doc public 前に spoofing、replay、volumetric abuse threat model を sign-off。
